title: The paper's Y2K issue
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
arc: The Last Week of the Century
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The college paper's holiday issue asks Wood for a millennium strip. He draws a strip about being asked for a millennium strip. They run it. The strip has learned it can do this.

panels.composition: The print shop, the machine back early, the TECH unplugging the service tag. WOOD with a strip. BARNABY.

balloons.text: I told them that. They still want it.

image.prompt: a print technician pulling a service tag off a large copier while a young man holds a comic strip and a dog waits, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The strip Wood hands over: four panels of a young man being asked for a millennium strip, drawn in ninety seconds.

image.prompt: close on a four-panel comic strip drawn quickly showing a young man being asked for a strip by a technician, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The tech reading it. Looking up.

image.prompt: a print technician reading a comic strip and looking up at the young man who drew it, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The copier's light sweeping over the strip about the copier. The strip has learned the trick and will use it for twenty-eight years.

image.prompt: a photocopier's green light sweeping across a comic strip lying on its glass, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The strip about being asked. The trick, learned. Used through 2027.
